crenate.definition: s. having a margin with rounded scallops
crenate.translation:
a. 圆齿状的, 钝齿形的, 具圆齿的
[医] 纯锯齿形的, 有小裂口的(叶缘)

crenated.definition: s having a margin with rounded scallops
crenated.translation: a. 圆齿状的, 钝齿形的, 具圆齿的

crenation.definition: n one of a series of rounded projections (or the notches between them) formed by curves along an edge (as the edge of a leaf or piece of cloth or the margin of a shell or a shriveled red blood cell observed in a hypertonic solution etc.)
crenation.translation:
n. 钝锯齿
[医] 纯锯齿形; 皱缩(红细胞)

crenation degeneration.translation: [医] 皱缩变性(见于蕈样肉芽肿时)

crenature.definition: n one of a series of rounded projections (or the notches between them) formed by curves along an edge (as the edge of a leaf or piece of cloth or the margin of a shell or a shriveled red blood cell observed in a hypertonic solution etc.)

crenel.definition:
n. a notch or open space between two merlons in a crenelated battlement
v. supply with battlements
crenel.translation:
n. 雉堞上的凹处, 枪眼
vt. 使...成雉堞状

crenelate.translation: vt. 在(墙)上开枪眼, 使成雉堞状

crenelated.translation: a. 雉堞状的, 在墙上打枪眼[炮眼]

crenelating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Crenelate
crenelating.translation: vt. 在…上开枪眼；使成雉堞状（等于crenellate）

crenelation.definition: n. the action of constructing ramparts with gaps for firing guns or arrows
crenelation.translation: n. 开枪眼的工事, 开枪眼的工程, 雉堞

crenellate.translation: vt. 在(墙)上开枪眼, 使成雉堞状

crenellates.translation: vt. 在(墙)上开枪眼, 使成雉堞状

crenellating.translation: vt. 在(墙)上开枪眼, 使成雉堞状

crenellation.definition:
n a rampart built around the top of a castle with regular gaps for firing arrows or guns
n the action of constructing ramparts with gaps for firing guns or arrows
crenellation.translation: n. 开枪眼的工事, 开枪眼的工程, 雉堞

crenellations.definition:
plural of crenellation
n a rampart built around the top of a castle with regular gaps for firing arrows or guns
n the action of constructing ramparts with gaps for firing guns or arrows
crenellations.translation: (crenellation 的复数) n. 开枪眼的工事, 开枪眼的工程, 雉堞

crenelle.definition:
n one of a series of rounded projections (or the notches between them) formed by curves along an edge (as the edge of a leaf or piece of cloth or the margin of a shell or a shriveled red blood cell observed in a hypertonic solution etc.)
n a notch or open space between two merlons in a crenelated battlement
crenelle.translation: 城或墙顶之垛口,枪眼,炮门

crenic acid.translation:
[化] 白腐酸
[医] 白腐酸

crenulate.definition: s having a margin with small rounded teeth
crenulate.translation: a. 细圆齿状的, 小圆齿状的

crenulated.translation: a. 细圆齿状的, 小圆齿状的

crenulation.definition:
n. A minute crenation.
n. The state of being minutely scalloped.
